notes.title: HELP ME NOW - DEFINITIVE EDITION
notes.notes:
[u][b]Help Me Now - Definitive Edition[/b][/u] is the biggest free update developed for the classic suspense. This new version of the product aims to provide a more realistic, immersive and complete experience, through various graphic, technical and gameplay enhancements. The update makes the game much more alive and introduces an extraordinary level of detail to the scenarios and characters. Check out the contents of the update below!

[b]Graphical[/b] improvements:

[list]
[*][b]High quality of 3D models[/b] (Presence of more polygons);
[*][b]Textures in high resolution[/b] (4K - 4096x4096);
[*][b]Reworked lighting[/b] (Intensity, range and color ation of light sources have changed);
[*][b]Reworked shadows[/b] (Intensity, position and resolution of them have changed);
[*][b]More abundant particles[/b] (Quantity and position of the same have changed);
[*][b]High resolution reflexes and more present; [/b]
[*][b]Color tone were modified; [/b]
[*][b]The rendering distance has been increased. [/b]
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b] improvements:

[list]
[*][b]Implementation of the Save/Load system;[/b]
[*][b]Artificial intelligence of the enemies have been redone;[/b]
[*][b]The difficulty was adjusted;[/b]
[*][b]The voice acting of the characters were redone;[/b]
[*][b]Interface and reworked texts.[/b]
[/list]

[b]Technical[/b] improvements:

[list]
[*][b] The times spent on the loading screens were significantly decreased; [/b]
[*][b] Game optimization has been improved;[/b]
[*][b] Quality options (Very high, High, Medium, Low, Very Low) have been modified for more performance and quality;[/b]
[*][b] The bugs present in the previous version have been fixed.[/b]
[/list]

[b]Comparative[/b] images:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36970323/263d7df9fd4e20a788d9519d759d9d0fc2e5cdb8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36970323/52b16a4db782b3e43f4fb9b43a0ebad7b10b458b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36970323/c1e2fc2ab7703d00772bfa7b241b9463e1ae1747.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36970323/2b66860652d9758f09095a7d690a4891c7fd5369.png[/img]

These are the main improvements, however there are many others. The [u][b]Definitive Edition[/b][/u] version will be available from the date of publication of this announcement. Update the game to enjoy the best experience!

Sincerely, Light Station Developer team.

notes.title: Launch of a new free DLC!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE} /36970323/82dd1c295e31433b43f76fb4942f18e509171dce.png[/img]

Hello Help Me Now players! We are here to announce the new free additional content that will be available in the game from the date of publication of this announcement. Help Me Now will receive a free DLC called "Origin of the End". Below we will describe it and present more details about it. First of all we want to thank you very much for the support of you, players of the game! The development of this DLC was only possible due to your support! So thank you very much!

[b]Introduction[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE} /36970323/24eca2a612d32f5a6635a7e783a5b64d665b7cb4.png[/img]

This new free DLC will add an extremely realistic and extensive scenario to be explored by the player while solving puzzles, mysteries and various bizarre events to achieve his main objective: entering the mansion. In this additional content you control Thomas Histed, 1 hour and 30 minutes before waking up unconsciously in the room where "Story Mode" starts. You will need to explore a huge scenario, solve puzzles, take care of your hunger, thirst, stamina, life, sanity, batteries in your flashlight, create a plan, collect resources and think in order to discover the truth behind many mysterious events and conclude the DLC.

However, do you think it will be that easy? So be aware that it is not. While you are exploring the scene and progressing in the game you will need to deal with TREEKY, another biological weapon created by Tamara. TREEKY was created to kill anyone who tried to approach the mansion ...

[b]Synopsis[/b]

In this free DLC you control Thomas Histed, 1 hour and 30 minutes before waking up unconsciously in the room where "Story Mode" starts. Thomas, in this DLC, had just arrived at the supposed location of the Jones family mansion and needed to enter the mansion to begin his investigative work, however, this action was more complicated ...

[b]Characteristics[/b]
[list]
[*] Explore a huge scenario, search for resources, solve puzzles, mysteries and survive;
[*] Take care of your hunger, thirst, stamina, life, sanity and the batteries present in your flashlight to continue the game.
[*] New puzzles and mysteries for the main plot;
[*] Implementation of a superior graphic extension in relation to lighting and reflections;
[*] Various revelations;
[*] Addictive, engaging and fun gameplay!
[*] Free additional content!
[*] And much more!
[/list]
[b]How to play?[/b]

To play this new free additional content you will follow these steps outlined below:

[b]Start the game >> In the main menu, click the "DLCs" button >> Click "Play" >> Done![/b]

[b]Attention[/b]
[list]
[*] Attention, all content presented in the DLC and in the game has a fictional origin.
[*] Attention, this DLC was implemented with heavier graphics resources, such as improved post-processing effects, so this can generate more processing and higher memory consumption compared to "History Mode".
[/list]

notes.title: One month since launch! Free additional content?
notes.notes:
Hello Help Me Now players! I'm Lucas Lopes Baroni, developer of the game Help Me Now. I'm writing this news to say and celebrate the first one month of the game's release! Thank you very much to all of you who bought, liked and had fun with the product offered by me, thank you very much! I always had this dream of completing a product and launching it on the market, and this dream came true a month ago! Thank you!

However, I am writing this news to informally announce something very cool! The Help Me Now game will soon receive new free additional content, that's right, a free DLC for game players! This DLC will add new scenarios, stories, revelations, puzzles, mysteries and more! I am very happy with the result of the content and very excited to share more information about this DLC! Soon I will announce it formally and announce the release date of this new content! Wait...

Again, THANK YOU SO MUCH!

:)

notes.title: Theories contest!
notes.notes:
Hello Help Me Now players! We are here to announce a new event that will take place in the game over the next three weeks! This event will be a theory contest, that's right, theorize! To participate in the event you must develop a theory that explains the history and general events of the game! After elaborating your theory write it and publish it in the discussions tab present in the community center! The player who creates the most sensible and weird theory will win the event! The theory created does not need to be true and does not necessarily have to be related to all the facts. Theory can be as you see fit, however you like, but in a way, it needs to make sense! The winner of the event will receive the new DLC for the product in advance and will win their own easter egg in the game! You saw that TOP! So, let's go!

:)

Speedruns contest!

The winner of the event will have an exclusive easter egg in the game and will receive the future game DLC in advance! So, let's start!
